title: Standards and Regulatory Alignment
description: External standards, risk governance frameworks, legislation, government directives, and internal control crosswalks.
disclaimer: Regulatory and legal compliance requirements are subject to jurisdictional changes and require legal verification.

categories.title: International Standards
categories.summary: Voluntary consensus standards published by international standards bodies (ISO, IEC).

items.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
items.title: Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS)
items.applicability: Certifiable benchmark for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and improving an AI management system.

items.name: ISO 31000:2018
items.title: Risk Management Guidelines
items.applicability: Generic guidelines for managing risk faced by organisations, applied to AI risk governance.

items.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
items.title: Information Security Management Systems
items.applicability: Information security management foundation extended to protect AI data and model weights.

categories.title: AI Risk & Governance Frameworks
categories.summary: Practical guidance, taxonomy, and controls for managing AI risks.

items.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
items.title: NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
items.applicability: Functions across Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage to improve AI trustworthiness.

items.name: IEEE 7000-2021
items.title: Standard Model Process for Addressing Ethical Concerns During System Design
items.applicability: Methodology for identifying and mitigating ethical values conflicts in AI systems design.

categories.title: Legislation and Regulation
categories.summary: Binding legal requirements, statutes, and regulatory enforcement expectations.

items.name: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689)
items.title: European Union Artificial Intelligence Act
items.applicability: Binding risk-classified obligations for providers, deployers, and importers of AI systems in the EU market.
items.verificationNote: Specific enforcement deadlines (e.g. GPAI rules, High-Risk System rules) require legal verification per release date.

items.name: UK GDPR & DPA 2018
items.title: Data Protection Act 2018 & General Data Protection Regulation
items.applicability: Lawful basis, automated decision-making (Art 22), data protection impact assessments (DPIA), and rights of data subjects.

categories.title: Government Directives & Policy Principles
categories.summary: Mandates and guidance issued by government executive offices for public sector and regulated domain AI adoption.

items.name: US OMB Memorandum M-24-10
items.title: Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence
items.issuingBody: US Office of Management and Budget
items.applicability: Mandates Chief AI Officers, AI asset inventories, impact assessments, and minimum risk safeguards for federal agencies.

items.name: UK AI Regulation Principles
items.title: Pro-innovation Approach to AI Regulation
items.applicability: Five principles (Safety/Security, Transparency/Explainability, Fairness, Accountability, Redress) interpreted by sectoral regulators (FCA, ICO, CMA, MHRA).
items.verificationNote: Sectoral regulator guidance updates (e.g. FCA, ICO) must be verified against current regulator publications.

categories.title: Control Crosswalks & Evidence
categories.summary: Internal control mappings aligning technical evidence to external standards and legislative expectations.

items.name: Enterprise AI Control Crosswalk
items.title: Multi-Framework Mapping Matrix (ISO 42001, NIST RMF, EU AI Act)
items.applicability: Maps single deliverable outputs to multiple external standards requirements to prevent duplicate evidence generation.
